correctionReason: The original baseline artifact was reclaimed and an exact source-id rebuild produced different artifact bytes. No headless base or final performance samples had run. This policy freezes the recovered v2 measurement harness and rebuilt baseline identities before fresh base/final sampling without changing workload, sampling, budgets, or noise rules.

fixture.prompt: Return the exact text: headless fixture complete

sampling.noisePolicy: Do not discard individual samples. Any timeout, identity mismatch, fixture mismatch, orphan process, or foreign-process interference invalidates the complete base/final set and requires a fresh rerun.

budgets.requiredBehavior: Every sample must complete the capabilities handshake and the deterministic first turn through agent_settled, then leave no child process.
budgets.identity: Executable and staged-runtime hashes must match the selected OPT-017 build manifest exactly.
